zh-CN.quest.prism.detail.search: 前往潮汐浅滩，查看码头旁的箭纹石碑，点亮三座信标并取得棱镜。
zh-CN.quest.prism.detail.return: 携带棱镜回到晨湾港，交给管理员艾琳。
zh-CN.quest.prism.detail.completeWithSail: 棱镜已交付，灯塔重新点亮；晨鹱号已换上勘测帆。

zh-CN.quest.storm.detail.return: 将透镜带回晨湾港交给船匠乔恩。
zh-CN.quest.storm.detail.complete: 信号桅杆已修复。试玩版主线完成，可以继续自由探索。

zh-CN.hud.message.beaconLocked: 信标仍被海雾封住。先从晨湾港告示牌接取灯塔委托。
zh-CN.hud.message.beaconsAllLit: 三座潮汐信标已经共鸣，棱镜祭台已经开启。
zh-CN.hud.message.beaconWrongOrder: 潮音消散了。石碑上的箭纹从西向东排列，试着按那个顺序重新点亮。
zh-CN.hud.message.beaconComplete: 三座潮汐信标回应了彼此。棱镜祭台已开启。
zh-CN.hud.message.beaconLit: 信标已点亮：{0}/{1}。沿着箭纹继续寻找下一座。
zh-CN.quest.storm.objective.search: 在潮汐浅滩的坍塌灯塔旁寻找风暴透镜。
zh-CN.quest.storm.objective.return: 把风暴透镜交给晨湾港的船匠乔恩。
zh-CN.hud.message.jon.chartFirst: 乔恩：等艾琳把航图理清，我们才能知道风暴信号该指向哪里。
zh-CN.hud.message.storm.newQuest: 新委托：帮乔恩从潮汐浅滩的坍塌灯塔取回风暴透镜，修好港口信号桅杆。
zh-CN.hud.message.jon.stormHint: 乔恩：风暴透镜是块蓝白色晶片，就在坍塌灯塔旁的碎石间。
zh-CN.hud.message.storm.complete: 试玩版主线完成：港口信号桅杆重新亮起。你仍可自由探索群岛。
zh-CN.hud.message.jon.afterStorm: 乔恩：信号桅杆工作得很漂亮。晨鹱号已经准备好继续探索。
zh-CN.hud.message.storm.lensLocked: 风暴透镜折射着微光。先向乔恩问清它的用途。
zh-CN.quest.chart.objective.search: 前往潮汐浅滩的遗迹，找回失落的航图。
zh-CN.quest.chart.objective.return: 把失落航图交给晨湾港管理员艾琳。
zh-CN.hud.message.eileen.prismFirst: 艾琳：先完成灯塔棱镜的委托，晨湾港才有能力重绘航线。
zh-CN.hud.message.chart.newQuest: 新委托：遗迹里遗失了一张旧航图。前往潮汐浅滩，把它带回来。
zh-CN.hud.message.eileen.chartHint: 艾琳：航图应该还在潮汐浅滩遗迹的石台旁。
zh-CN.hud.message.chart.complete: 委托完成：艾琳将航图挂上港口导航台，未知海域的轮廓显现了。
zh-CN.hud.message.eileen.afterChart: 艾琳：多亏这张航图，我们终于能看清下一片海域。
zh-CN.hud.message.chart.locked: 一张被潮水浸湿的航图。也许艾琳会知道它的用途。
zh-CN.quest.prism.objective.notAccepted: 查看港口告示牌，取得前往潮汐浅滩的线索。
zh-CN.quest.prism.objective.search: 航向潮汐浅滩，依次点亮三座潮汐信标，开启棱镜祭台。
zh-CN.quest.prism.objective.return: 带着棱镜零件返回晨湾港，交给港口管理员。
zh-CN.quest.prism.objective.complete: 灯塔棱镜已送回晨湾港。航线修复工作即将开始。
zh-CN.hud.message.prism.locked: 这块棱镜属于失修灯塔。先去港口告示牌查看委托。
zh-CN.hud.message.quest.managerWaiting: 管理员正在等候潮汐浅滩的灯塔线索。
zh-CN.hud.message.prism.complete: 委托完成：晨湾港灯塔已重新点亮。去找船匠乔恩领取勘测帆。
zh-CN.hud.message.boarded: 已登船：W/S 加减速，A/D 转向；手柄用左摇杆。靠岸减速后按 E / A 下船。
zh-CN.hud.landing.tideflats.searchBeacons: 已到潮汐浅滩：先查看码头附近的箭纹石碑，再依序点亮信标。
zh-CN.hud.landing.tideflats.searchChart: 已到潮汐浅滩：前往遗迹入口石台，找回失落航图。
zh-CN.hud.landing.tideflats.searchLens: 已到潮汐浅滩：到坍塌灯塔旁寻找蓝白色风暴透镜。
zh-CN.hud.landing.tideflats.free: 已到潮汐浅滩：继续自由探索。按 E 或手柄 A 与附近物件交互。
zh-CN.hud.landing.harbour.deliverPrism: 已返晨湾港：把棱镜交给港口管理员艾琳。
zh-CN.hud.landing.harbour.deliverChart: 已返晨湾港：把航图交给港口管理员艾琳。
zh-CN.hud.landing.harbour.deliverLens: 已返晨湾港：把风暴透镜交给船匠乔恩。
zh-CN.hud.landing.harbour.free: 已返晨湾港：继续探索，或向港口居民询问新的线索。
zh-CN.hud.message.recover.tideflats: 海浪把你送回了潮汐浅滩。先找到码头，再登上晨鹱号。
zh-CN.hud.message.recover.harbour: 海浪把你送回了晨湾港。码头的小船仍在等你。
zh-CN.hud.message.shallow: 前方是浅滩。请转向码头航道。
zh-CN.hud.message.disembarkTooFast: 请减速并靠近码头后再下船。
zh-CN.sign.tideflatsRoute.title: 潮汐浅滩航线
zh-CN.sign.tideflatsRoute.body: 从主码头登上晨鹱号，向南航行到潮汐浅滩码头。靠岸时减速，再按 E 下船。
zh-CN.sign.lighthousePier.title: 灯塔栈桥
zh-CN.sign.lighthousePier.body: 晨湾港灯塔在东侧。带回棱镜交给艾琳，才能重新点亮灯塔。
zh-CN.sign.tideflatsRuin.title: 潮汐遗迹
zh-CN.sign.tideflatsRuin.body: 码头西侧的蓝纹石碑记着信标顺序；遗迹入口在岛屿东侧，坍塌灯塔在西南侧。
zh-CN.object.prism.title: 破损的灯塔棱镜
zh-CN.object.chart.title: 失落航图
zh-CN.object.stormLens.title: 风暴透镜
zh-CN.object.clueTablet.title: 潮汐箭纹石碑
zh-CN.message.clueTablet.order: 石碑上的灯纹从西向东排列：西侧信标 → 中央信标 → 东侧信标。
zh-CN.object.boat.title: 晨鹱号
zh-CN.object.noticeBoard.title: 港口告示牌
zh-CN.prompt.noticeBoard.accept: 前往潮汐浅滩，寻找灯塔棱镜零件
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.surveySail: 棱镜送回来了！我现在给晨鹱号换上勘测帆，航速和转向都会更灵活。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.stormHint: 风暴透镜是块蓝白色晶片，就在坍塌灯塔旁的碎石间。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.stormReturn: 你回来了？让我看看那枚透镜。港口的信号桅杆终于能再亮起来了。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.allDiscoveries: 你把四件旧物都找齐了。罗盘与护符上的刻痕相合，这片海还有未讲完的故事。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.afterStorm: 信号桅杆工作得很漂亮。晨鹱号已经准备好继续探索。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.charmHint: 信号桅杆亮了。浅滩东南侧旧路边，据说有人遗失过守望者护符。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.idleWithCompass: 海雾不会永远散去，但一艘好船能让你走得更远。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.idleNoCompass: 修船屋门前有只褪色罗盘，指针总偏向潮汐浅滩。
zh-CN.dialogue.jon.demoEnding: 试玩版主线已完成。你可以继续自由探索晨湾港与潮汐浅滩，寻找尚未发现的线索。感谢试玩《雾灯群岛》！
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.notAccepted: 你愿意替港口跑一趟吗？潮汐浅滩的灯塔棱镜失踪了。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.searchTideflats: 潮雾涨得很快。石碑上的箭纹会带你找到信标。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.returnPrism: 那道光……你真的找到了棱镜。把它交给我，晨湾港就有希望重新点亮。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartUnlockWithLog: 灯塔亮起来后，旧航图上的航线也许终于能重新辨认。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartUnlockNoLog: 灯塔亮起来后，旧航图也许能辨认。港务办公室门前还有一页潮湿日志。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartSearch: 遗迹里的航图被潮水浸透了，但它仍标着一条通往未知海域的线。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartReturn: 让我看看那张航图。它会告诉我们迷雾外还有什么。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.allDiscoveries: 日志、罗盘、贝壳和护符都在你的笔记里了。旧航线的线索终于能留在晨湾港。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartDoneWithShell: 有了航图，晨湾港不再只是雾里的一个孤岛。
zh-CN.dialogue.eileen.chartDoneNoShell: 有了航图，晨湾港不再孤立。浅滩西侧海边似乎传来三次潮鸣。
zh-CN.hud.message.jon.prismFirst: 乔恩：先带回潮汐浅滩的灯塔棱镜，我会给晨鹱号换上一套勘测帆。
zh-CN.hud.message.jon.sailInstalled: 乔恩：勘测帆已经装好。它能提高航速和转向响应。
zh-CN.hud.message.boatUpgrade: 船只升级完成：勘测帆已安装（最高航速 +2.5，转向速度 +8）。

en.quest.prism.detail.search: Sail to the Tideflats, read the arrow-carved stone by the pier, light all three beacons and take the prism.
en.quest.prism.detail.return: Carry the prism back to Morning Bay and give it to Eileen.
en.quest.prism.detail.completeWithSail: Prism delivered and the lighthouse burns again; the Dawn Petrel carries her survey sail.
en.quest.prism.detail.completeNoSail: Prism delivered and the harbour light burns again. Collect your survey sail from Jon.
en.quest.prism.detail.notAccepted: Read the lighthouse notice on the Morning Bay board.
en.quest.chart.detail.search: Recover the lost chart from the stone table at the Tideflats ruin.
en.quest.chart.detail.return: Bring the chart back to Eileen in Morning Bay.
en.quest.chart.detail.complete: Chart delivered; a new course takes shape.
en.quest.chart.detail.locked: Once the harbour light is restored, ask Eileen about the old chart.
en.quest.storm.detail.search: Search beside the collapsed lighthouse on the Tideflats for a blue-white storm lens.
en.quest.storm.detail.return: Bring the lens back to Jon the shipwright in Morning Bay.
en.quest.storm.detail.complete: Signal mast repaired. The demo's story is complete — keep exploring as you like.
en.quest.storm.detail.locked: After the chart is done, ask Jon about the storm lens.

en.discovery.harbourLog.title: Waterlogged Harbour Log
en.discovery.harbourLog.note: The last page records the date the fog-bound lighthouse changed hands; the ink has bled away in seawater.
en.discovery.oldCompass.title: Faded Old Compass
en.discovery.oldCompass.note: Its needle always leans toward the Tideflats, matching the course on the old chart.
en.discovery.tideShell.title: Echoing Tide Shell
en.discovery.tideShell.note: Held to your ear, it answers with three tides' worth of sound.
en.discovery.watchersCharm.title: Watcher's Charm
en.discovery.watchersCharm.note: The back is carved with an old ship sailing out of Morning Bay.
en.hud.discovery.allFound: All four relics found ({0}/{1}). Old sea-lanes surface — ask Eileen and Jon back at harbour. Press J / Gamepad Y for your notes.
en.hud.discovery.found: Discovery: {0} ({1}/{2}). Press J / Gamepad Y for your notes.
en.prompt.dock.board: Board once the Dawn Petrel is docked
en.hud.message.boatNotNearDock: The Dawn Petrel isn't at this dock yet. Follow the route to find her.
en.hud.message.beaconLocked: Sea fog still seals the beacon. Accept the lighthouse job from the Morning Bay notice board first.
en.hud.message.beaconsAllLit: All three tide beacons resonate. The prism altar is open.
en.hud.message.beaconWrongOrder: The tide-song fades. The arrows on the stone run west to east — light them in that order.
en.hud.message.beaconComplete: The three tide beacons answer one another. The prism altar is open.
en.hud.message.beaconLit: Beacon lit: {0}/{1}. Follow the arrows to the next one.
en.quest.storm.objective.search: Search beside the collapsed lighthouse on the Tideflats for the storm lens.
en.quest.storm.objective.return: Deliver the storm lens to Jon the shipwright in Morning Bay.
en.hud.message.jon.chartFirst: Jon: Not until Eileen sorts that chart. Then we'll know where the storm signal should point.
en.hud.message.storm.newQuest: New job: fetch the storm lens from the collapsed Tideflats lighthouse so Jon can fix the harbour signal mast.
en.hud.message.jon.stormHint: Jon: The storm lens is a blue-white shard, down in the rubble beside the collapsed light.
en.hud.message.storm.complete: Demo story complete: the harbour signal mast burns again. The isles are still yours to roam.
en.hud.message.jon.afterStorm: Jon: The mast's running sweet. The Dawn Petrel's ready when you are.
en.hud.message.storm.lensLocked: The storm lens catches the light. Ask Jon what it's for first.
en.quest.chart.objective.search: Head for the Tideflats ruin and recover the lost chart.
en.quest.chart.objective.return: Bring the lost chart to Eileen, the Morning Bay harbourmaster.
en.hud.message.eileen.prismFirst: Eileen: Finish the prism job first. Then Morning Bay can chart the lanes again.
en.hud.message.chart.newQuest: New job: an old chart was lost in the ruin. Bring it back from the Tideflats.
en.hud.message.eileen.chartHint: Eileen: The chart should still be by the stone table in the Tideflats ruin.
en.hud.message.chart.complete: Job done: Eileen pins the chart to the harbour table, and unknown waters take shape.
en.hud.message.eileen.afterChart: Eileen: Thanks to this chart, we can finally see the next stretch of sea.
en.hud.message.chart.locked: A tide-soaked chart. Eileen might know what it's for.
en.quest.prism.objective.notAccepted: Read the harbour notice board for the way to the Tideflats.
en.quest.prism.objective.search: Sail to the Tideflats, light the three tide beacons in order and open the prism altar.
en.quest.prism.objective.return: Carry the prism back to Morning Bay and hand it to the harbourmaster.
en.quest.prism.objective.complete: The prism is back in Morning Bay. The sea-lanes can be mended now.
en.hud.message.prism.locked: This prism belongs to the broken light. Read the harbour notice board first.
en.hud.message.quest.managerWaiting: The harbourmaster is waiting for word from the Tideflats light.
en.hud.message.prism.complete: Job done: Morning Bay's light burns again. See Jon the shipwright for your survey sail.
en.hud.message.boarded: Aboard: W/S throttle, A/D steer; gamepad uses the left stick. Slow down at a dock, then press E / A to step off.
en.hud.landing.tideflats.searchBeacons: Tideflats. Read the arrow stone near the pier, then light the beacons in order.
en.hud.landing.tideflats.searchChart: Tideflats. The ruin's stone table holds the lost chart.
en.hud.landing.tideflats.searchLens: Tideflats. Look for the blue-white storm lens beside the collapsed light.
en.hud.landing.tideflats.free: Tideflats. Explore freely — press E or Gamepad A to interact.
en.hud.landing.harbour.deliverPrism: Back in Morning Bay. Give the prism to Eileen.
en.hud.landing.harbour.deliverChart: Back in Morning Bay. Give the chart to Eileen.
en.hud.landing.harbour.deliverLens: Back in Morning Bay. Give the storm lens to Jon.
en.hud.landing.harbour.free: Back in Morning Bay. Keep exploring, or ask the locals for new leads.
en.hud.message.recover.tideflats: The swell washed you back to the Tideflats. Find the pier and board the Dawn Petrel.
en.hud.message.recover.harbour: The swell washed you back to Morning Bay. Your boat is still waiting at the pier.
en.hud.message.shallow: Shoals ahead. Steer for the dock channel.
en.hud.message.disembarkTooFast: Slow down and come alongside a dock before stepping off.
en.sign.tideflatsRoute.title: Tideflats Route
en.sign.tideflatsRoute.body: Board the Dawn Petrel at the main dock and sail south to the Tideflats pier. Slow as you come alongside, then press E to step off.
en.sign.lighthousePier.title: Lighthouse Pier
en.sign.lighthousePier.body: Morning Bay's lighthouse stands to the east. Bring the prism back to Eileen to relight it.
en.sign.tideflatsRuin.title: Tideflats Ruin
en.sign.tideflatsRuin.body: The blue-marked stone west of the pier records the beacon order. The ruin entrance lies east of the island; the collapsed lighthouse, southwest.
en.object.prism.title: Broken Lighthouse Prism
en.object.chart.title: Lost Chart
en.object.stormLens.title: Storm Lens
en.object.clueTablet.title: Tide Arrow Stone
en.message.clueTablet.order: The light-marks run west to east: West Beacon → Central Beacon → East Beacon.
en.object.boat.title: Dawn Petrel
en.object.noticeBoard.title: Harbour Notice Board
en.prompt.noticeBoard.accept: Head to the Tideflats and find the lighthouse prism
en.dialogue.jon.surveySail: The prism's back! I'll fit the Dawn Petrel with a survey sail — she'll run faster and answer the helm quicker.
en.dialogue.jon.stormHint: Storm lens is a blue-white shard, in the rubble by the collapsed light.
en.dialogue.jon.stormReturn: Back already? Let me see that lens. The signal mast can finally burn again.
en.dialogue.jon.allDiscoveries: You found all four. The compass and the charm carry matching marks — this sea still has stories left in it.
en.dialogue.jon.afterStorm: Mast's running sweet. The Dawn Petrel's ready to go on.
en.dialogue.jon.charmHint: Mast's lit. Word is a Watcher's Charm was lost on the old road southeast of the flats.
en.dialogue.jon.idleWithCompass: The fog never lifts for good, but a good boat takes you further into it.
en.dialogue.jon.idleNoCompass: There's a faded compass outside the boathouse — needle always leans to the Tideflats.
en.dialogue.jon.demoEnding: The demo's main story is complete. Keep exploring Morning Bay and the Tideflats for clues you haven't found yet. Thanks for playing Foglight Isles!
en.dialogue.eileen.notAccepted: Would you run an errand for the harbour? The Tideflats lighthouse prism has gone missing.
en.dialogue.eileen.searchTideflats: The fog tide rises fast. The arrows on the stone will lead you to the beacons.
en.dialogue.eileen.returnPrism: That light... you truly found the prism. Give it to me, and Morning Bay has a chance to shine again.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartUnlockWithLog: With the light back, the old chart's lanes might finally be readable again.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartUnlockNoLog: With the light back, the old chart might be readable. There's also a waterlogged page outside the harbour office.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartSearch: The chart in the ruin is soaked through, but it still marks a line into unknown waters.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartReturn: Let me see that chart. It will tell us what lies beyond the fog.
en.dialogue.eileen.allDiscoveries: The log, the compass, the shell and the charm are all in your notes. At last the old routes can stay here in Morning Bay.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartDoneWithShell: With the chart, Morning Bay is no longer just an island in the fog.
en.dialogue.eileen.chartDoneNoShell: With the chart, Morning Bay is no longer alone. Three tide-calls seem to sound off the west shore of the flats.
en.hud.message.jon.prismFirst: Jon: Bring back the Tideflats prism first, and I'll fit the Dawn Petrel with a survey sail.
en.hud.message.jon.sailInstalled: Jon: Survey sail's fitted. She'll carry more speed and answer the helm faster.
en.hud.message.boatUpgrade: Boat upgraded: survey sail fitted (top speed +2.5, turn rate +8).
en.guidance.sailToMorningBay: Sail to the Morning Bay pier
en.guidance.boardBoatReturn: Board the Dawn Petrel for home
en.guidance.getSailFromJon: Get your survey sail from Jon
en.guidance.askEileenChart: Ask Eileen about the lost chart
en.guidance.askJonLens: Ask Jon about the storm lens
